_label: ESTIMATE (static model, tools/cp_gate.py) - NOT a simulation result; no simulation of the proposed graph or of any Civics Points economy exists. Inputs labelled MEASURED are read from measurements/.
status: PROPOSED analysis for Director review; every coefficient is a PROPOSED placeholder

equation.readingY: CP_turn = c_y * P^beta * dtYears (per sim-year rate, law 3)
equation.readingT: CP_turn = c_t * P^beta (per strategic turn; needs its own ADR, D-061.2)
equation.notModelled: institution/specialist terms (none exist in the running build: zero here, so CP is a lower bound with respect to them); Eurekas; foreign exposure; CP lost before the first civic is available (the A1-A2 civics of the proposal absorb it)
equation.notRP: CP is never computed from RP here; RP appears only in the MEASURED technology timings
